subject: Commit Gate: GPU availability & provisional hold for Aperture Systems
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T08:15:00Z
Subject: Internal check: Aperture Systems — GPU sizing & provisional hold request

Team,

Aperture (see hubspot link) is at legal-signature stage and is asking for a capacity commitment window to support a Feb 2027 launch for a heavy LLM inference workload. They asked for explicit availability before signing — they want a 12-month dedicated capacity profile.

Their nominal ask (from their infra/benchmarks): 8x H100-equivalent or 12x A100-80GB equivalent, sustained at 16 concurrent streams, average 1.2k seq length. Start target: 2027-02-01.

Can infra/op assess:
- short-term availability (Jan—Mar 2027) for the requested footprint by region(us)
- if we should offer a soft provisional hold (30 days) vs. an immediate hard reserve
- fallback plan (lower-perf model variants, burst to shared cluster) and estimated perf/cost delta

Attached is their SLA snapshot and the form they filled out. I need a one-paragraph summary + risk recommendation by EOD today so I can include it in the commercial redlines to procurement. If ops thinks a soft-hold is reasonable, propose the exact copy for the provisional hold email we can send the customer.

- Logan

---
Logan Wright
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0112
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Internal check: Aperture Systems — GPU sizing & provisional hold request

Logan —

Quick inventory/ops readout below (short answer: doable but with caveats).

1) Current inventory (us region, available for dedicated allocations in Jan — conservative):
   - A100-80GB: 36 available today, pockets across oak & sj clusters.
   - H100: 10 available, with 60–90 day procurement lead for additional units.

2) For Aperture profile: 12x A100-80GB fits comfortably if we convert from existing spare pool, but that will reduce our burst headroom for other late-stage deals across Jan–Mar. 8x H100 is tight; if they insist H100, procurement lead time risks slip.

3) Recommendations:
   - Offer a "30-day provisional hold" (soft hold) that: reserves capacity logically in our planning system, prevents reallocation for other commitments, but is revocable if customer doesn't sign in 30d.
   - Provide a fallback offer: 12x A100 equivalent with autoscaling to shared pool for peak bursts. Call out a 6–8% latency degradation at p95 for some large prompt shapes.

4) Operational ask: if approved, we need a provisioning ticket (PROV-XXXX) + ops-runbook to pin model image and quantization profile. Also need to reserve a maintenance window for model upload and compile.

I'll draft the soft-hold email copy if you want; also flagging potential conflict with a separate commitment in week 3 of Jan (we can shuffle less-critical soft-holds).

- Karthik

Date: 2026-11-18T13:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Aperture Systems — proposed provisional hold & action items (commercial)

Lena / Daniel —

Thanks for the quick call this morning. Per that conversation, we can provide a provisional hold to support your go-live planning. Internal ops confirmed availability for a 12x A100-80GB equivalent allocation in the US region with the following terms (provisional):

- Provisional hold term: 30 days from acceptance of this provisional hold email
- Capacity covered: logical reserve for 12x A100-80GB (or equivalent mix) starting Feb 1, 2027 — final hardware assignment at provisioning
- If contract signed and seeds are paid, we will convert provisional hold to a committed reservation with a 12-month term.
- If not signed within 30 days, hold expires; we will communicate 7 days prior to expiry.

Please confirm acceptance of the provisional hold and whether you prefer the A100-equivalent path or to commit to H100 procurement (note H100 supply is constrained and would require lead-time agreement).

Attached: the SLA snapshot you provided (for visibility) and the provisional hold template we use internally. If this looks good, indicate acceptance by replying with the text: "Aperture accepts the 30-day provisional hold for 12x A100-equivalent starting 2027-02-01."

Best,
Logan

Logan Wright

Logan —

Thanks. Aperture would like to accept a provisional hold for 30 days while final approvals route. We prefer the A100-equivalent path for now. Two quick Qs: can you confirm estimated monthly bill (token + reserved capacity amortized) for the 12x A100-equivalent committed conversion, and is any credit available for a first-year lock? Procurement will want to see a conservative monthly forecast to present to finance.

—Daniel
Procurement, Aperture Systems
